CDC assessed documentation of diagnoses co-occurring with an ICD-10 code for COVID-19 (U07.1) on U.S. death certificates from 2020
These findings support the accuracy of COVID-19 mortality surveillance in the United States using official death certificates.

methods_quotes.q: Any co-occurring ICD-10 code that appeared on the same line or above U07.1 in Part I was considered to be a chain-of-event condition.
Results were stratified by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and setting of death reported on the death certificate.
